title: Static Import Graph and Cycle Finder
instructions: In `importgraph.py` implement `build_import_graph`, a static analyser built on the `ast` module that resolves absolute, dotted and relative imports into edges between project modules, counting only import-time imports, and `find_cycles`, which reports every strongly connected component with more than one module.

evidence.label: Resolves absolute and relative imports and ignores stdlib or third-party modules
Reports a cycle as a sorted component
Function-level and TYPE_CHECKING imports create no edges
A relative import above the top-level package is ignored
A package module resolves relative imports against itself
Finds a three-module cycle and drops self-imports
Maps dotted and from-imports to the longest known module
Resolves multi-dot relative imports and ignores ones that climb too far
Every module is a node; class bodies and TYPE_CHECKING else-branches count; async functions do not
